name: Lemon-Herb Mediterranean Chicken
desc: Sheet-pan chicken with zucchini and burst tomatoes over lemony brown rice

ingredients.raw: 2 lemons (juice of both, zest of one)
ingredients.item: lemons (juice of both, zest of one)

steps: Start the rice: Combine 1 1/2 cups brown rice and 3 cups chicken broth with a pinch of salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and simmer 40 minutes . Remove from heat and let sit covered 5 minutes, then fluff.

Preheat & make the dressing: Heat oven to 425F. Pound 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts to an even 3/4-inch thickness and pat dry. Whisk 4 tablespoons olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons plus the zest, 4 garlic cloves, minced, 2 teaspoons dried oregano, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, 1 1/3 teaspoons salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper in a bowl.

Season everything: On a sheet pan, toss 2 medium zucchini, cut into half-moons, 2 cups cherry tomatoes, and 1 red onion, cut into wedges with about half the dressing. Rub the remaining dressing all over the chicken.
Arrange: Push the veggies to the edges and set the chicken in the center so it has direct contact with the pan.
Roast: Roast 18 to 20 minutes  , until the chicken reaches 160 to 162F on a thermometer and the tomatoes burst.

Rest & serve: Rest the chicken 5 minutes . Stir a little lemon zest into the rice, then serve the chicken and veggies over it. Top with 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled (optional) and 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped.
